tonight.headline: Warren banks 15.6; Jefferson's Friday practice decides the rest
body: Bad news first: nothing overnight on Justin Jefferson. He missed Wednesday and Thursday, ESPN still projects 18.7, and this afternoon's practice is his last before a designation. Jaylen Warren came in 1.4 under his number in a 27-24 loss at Cleveland: 17 carries for 93 and 3 catches for 33, 15.6 against 17.0. ESPN has you at 128.5 against Aye-Aye's 125.0, 52%.

Nothing to do this morning. Both open items resolve on this afternoon's reports: Addison covers Jefferson at 12:35 Sunday, and Monangai is compared with Tuten only if D'Andre Swift is ruled out. One thing changed under a bench player: Jaylen Wright was upgraded to a full practice Thursday, so Ollie Gordon's Miami work is now a real split.

case.label: The risk
case.body: Jefferson's 18.7 is still the number most likely to be wrong in this matchup. Two straight DNPs on the right ankle (Vikings.com 1 Oct). Last Word on NFL (2 Oct, 07:14 ET) finds it 'hard to imagine' he plays; that's an opinion, not a report, and he carries no designation yet.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Aye-Aye start Herbert (12.6), McCaffrey (20.3), Jeremiyah Love (15.6), Kyren Williams in the flex (13.1), St. Brown (20.2), McMillan (15.0), Tyler Warren (13.1) and the Eagles D/ST. McCaffrey was full Thursday after a rest day (49ers Webzone 1 Oct). St. Brown tweaked an ankle against the Jets but isn't on Detroit's report (Yahoo 1 Oct). Herbert isn't on the Chargers' report. None of them has played.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson practising this afternoon in any form: then it's a real game-time call and the Addison card stays unarmed until 12:35 Sunday. A doubtful or out tag: start Addison and stop waiting.

doFirst.subtitle: Carried, unchanged overnight: two missed practices, no designation yet. Friday's report is the early read.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Right-ankle sprain on his seventh snap against Tampa Bay. DNP Wednesday and DNP Thursday (Vikings.com 1 Oct; RotoWire). O'Connell: 'not in any place right now to talk about what that means for the weekend'. Nothing new overnight; Friday's practice is his last chance before a designation. ESPN still 18.7: not priced.

case.label: Why Addison, not Coker
case.body: lineup_check.py names Coker (13.0 to Addison's 11.6). Coker was limited Thursday with his quad and Canales gave him 'a chance to play this week' (Panthers.com; Yahoo), but he plays Sunday night: his inactives come at 16:50, after the Vikings kick off at 14:05. Start a questionable Coker and he sits, and the slot scores zero. Addison is in Jefferson's game and drew 9 targets after Jefferson left in Week 3 (archive).

case.label: The exception
case.body: If Coker carries no designation on Friday's report and ESPN projects him above Addison at 12:35, take the projection and start Coker.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and Addison scores less than Coker that week.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · if Swift is ruled out; both lock Sun 11:00 Mexico City
doFirst.title: If Swift is ruled out: compare Monangai with Tuten
doFirst.subtitle: Carried from Thursday afternoon. No update overnight. Don't move on the news itself; move only if ESPN's new number says so.

case.label: The news
case.body: D'Andre Swift was added to Chicago's report Thursday with a knee injury and did not practise, a day after 20 carries on Monday night and a Wednesday with no listing (Chicago Sun-Times; NBC, 1 Oct). No designation yet (Last Word on NFL, 2 Oct 07:52 ET). It broke after projections were set: Monangai is still 8.4.

case.label: The role
case.body: Monangai has taken exactly 10 carries in each game, a third of the backfield, behind Swift's two thirds (archive). If Swift sits, the Sun-Times names Monangai as the main beneficiary, with Roschon Johnson also getting work. Chicago still hasn't named a quarterback: Bagent is expected over Keenum (Yahoo 29 Sep), not confirmed.

case.label: The rule
case.body: If Swift is ruled out, ESPN will re-project Monangai. Tuten (12.7) is your lowest starting back and both kick off at 11:00. Start whichever the projection then prefers; inside two points it's a coin flip, and the projection still decides.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and the back you bench outscores the back you start.

whatWentWrong.lead: Monangai 8.4 yesterday, 8.4 today. Swift went from 20 carries Monday to no practice Thursday.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Added to the report Thursday as a DNP (Chicago Sun-Times; NBC 1 Oct). Caleb Williams also missed again and is on track to sit a second game; Ben Johnson says he has picked his quarterback and won't say who.

case.label: What it changes

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Swift practising Friday with no designation: the card never arms and Monangai is a sixth back again.

worthALook.name: DK Metcalf
worthALook.lead: 88% rostered everywhere else and unowned here. He can't be added before Wednesday, so this is Tuesday's decision.

case.label: The role
case.body: 9 targets, 5 catches, 115 yards and 16.5 points on 69 snaps Thursday (Week 4 live archive; Fantasy Index 1 Oct), from a quarterback who threw 40 times. 9, 5, 9 targets over three games, 24% of Pittsburgh's. Michael Pittman Jr. managed 2 for 15 on 51 snaps beside him (PFF).

case.label: The number that kills it today
case.body: He has already played Week 4 and is locked on waivers until Wed 7 Oct, 01:00 Mexico City. ESPN projected him 10.1 this week, below Addison (11.6), and the waiver tool, on Weeks 1–3, says nothing clears this roster's bar.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday's run, before claims process. Chem's priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting. The drop is whichever of Addison and Monangai Sunday leaves without a role: Addison if Jefferson plays, Monangai if Swift does.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Nothing on the wire beats this roster on usage, from three weeks of data, which is still thin. The weakest movable players are Monangai and Addison, and both are spoken for this week: Swift's knee and Jefferson's ankle.
